key: ???: Hi, who are you?!
en: ???: Hi, who are you?!
ja: ???: こんにちは、あなた誰?!

key: Why are you all glowy?
en: Why are you all glowy?
ja: なんで全身光ってるの?

key: ???: Nobody is glowing, Anna.
en: ???: Nobody is glowing, Anna.
ja: ???: 誰も光ってないよ、アンナ。

key: ANNA: Huh?
en: ANNA: Huh?
ja: アンナ: え?

key: But that person clearly is!
en: But that person clearly is!
ja: でもその人、明らかに光ってるもん!

key: Oh, forget it.
en: Oh, forget it.
ja: ああ、もういいや。

key: Come on! I'll introduce you to everybody!
en: Come on! I'll introduce you to everybody!
ja: 来て! みんなを紹介するね!

key: Okay! So, I'm Anna--
en: Okay! So, I'm Anna--
ja: はい! それで、あたしはアンナ――

key: Hi!
en: Hi!
ja: こんにちは!

key: And this is my Jirachi, Nostra!
en: And this is my Jirachi, Nostra!
ja: それでこれが、あたしのジラーチ、ノストラ!

key: She says 'It's nice to meet you!'
en: She says 'It's nice to meet you!'
ja: 「はじめまして!」だって!

key: Over there is my twin brother, Noel, and his Cleffa, Nomos!
en: Over there is my twin brother, Noel, and his Cleffa, Nomos!
ja: あっちにいるのが、双子の弟のノエルと、そのピィのノモス!

key: NOEL: Nomos and Nostra are just dolls,
en: NOEL: Nomos and Nostra are just dolls,
ja: ノエル: ノモスとノストラは、ただの人形だよ、

key: But hi.
en: But hi.
ja: でも、こんにちは。

key: Uh, Nomos says 'Hi', too, I guess.
en: Uh, Nomos says 'Hi', too, I guess.
ja: ええと、ノモスも「こんにちは」って、たぶん。

key: ANNA: Don't lie, Noel; they're not "just dolls"!
en: ANNA: Don't lie, Noel; they're not "just dolls"!
ja: アンナ: うそつかないで、ノエル、「ただの人形」なんかじゃないもん!

key: They're important magical guardians our parents left for us!
en: They're important magical guardians our parents left for us!
ja: 二人は、両親があたしたちに残してくれた、大事な魔法の守護者なんだから!

key: Other than my pendant, they're all we have from them, so stop being ridiculous!
en: Other than my pendant, they're all we have from them, so stop being ridiculous!
ja: あたしのペンダント以外だと、二人だけが両親からもらったものなんだから、バカなこと言わないで!

key: NOEL: You're one to talk.
en: NOEL: You're one to talk.
ja: ノエル: 姉さんこそ、よく言うよ。

key: ANNA: Anyway!
en: ANNA: Anyway!
ja: アンナ: とにかく!

key: That's my friend, Charlotte!
en: That's my friend, Charlotte!
ja: あれがあたしの友達、シャルロット!

key: She's actually really, really pretty. You just have to see through the burn scars.
en: She's actually really, really pretty. You just have to see through the burn scars.
ja: 実はすっごくすっごくきれいなの。やけどの傷さえ気にしなければね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Anna, for the last time, I don't have any scars.
en: CHARLOTTE: Anna, for the last time, I don't have any scars.
ja: シャルロット: アンナ、もう何度も言ってるけど、傷なんてないから。

key: NOEL: She's not lying, Anna.
en: NOEL: She's not lying, Anna.
ja: ノエル: 彼女、うそはついてないよ、姉さん。

key: ANNA: But--
en: ANNA: But--
ja: アンナ: でも――

key: Oh, right!
en: Oh, right!
ja: あ、そうだった!

key: I'm sorry-- I'm so insensitive!
en: I'm sorry-- I'm so insensitive!
ja: ごめん――あたし、ほんと無神経だった!

key: I won't talk about them anymore, I promise!
en: I won't talk about them anymore, I promise!
ja: もう二度とその話しないから、約束する!

key: I was just saying that you're pretty!
en: I was just saying that you're pretty!
ja: ただ、きれいだって言いたかっただけなの!

key: CHARLOTTE: There's nothing to not talk about...
en: CHARLOTTE: There's nothing to not talk about...
ja: シャルロット: 話さないようにするようなことなんて、そもそも何もないんだけど……

key: Tch, never mind.
en: Tch, never mind.
ja: ちっ、もういいわ。

key: Hi.
en: Hi.
ja: どうも

key: You... have a strange scent about you.
en: You... have a strange scent about you.
ja: あなた……なんだか変わった匂いがするわね。

key: That perfume... You've met Laura, haven't you?
en: That perfume... You've met Laura, haven't you?
ja: その香水……ローラに会ったことあるでしょ?

key: Did she mention me? She's my sister.
en: Did she mention me? She's my sister.
ja: あたしのこと、何か言ってた? あたしの姉なの。

key: Also one of Reborn's Elite Four.
en: Also one of Reborn's Elite Four.
ja: それに、リボーンの四天王の一人でもあるわ。

key: NOEL: If you're going to say that, you may as well mention how Anna--
en: NOEL: If you're going to say that, you may as well mention how Anna--
ja: ノエル: それを言うなら、姉さんのことも言った方が――

key: ANNA: Yeah! Laura's so cool!
en: ANNA: Yeah! Laura's so cool!
ja: アンナ: そう! ローラってすっごくかっこいいの!

key: And Charlotte and Noel are also Gym Leaders~
en: And Charlotte and Noel are also Gym Leaders~
ja: それに、シャルロットとノエルもジムリーダーなんだよ~

key: CHARLOTTE: Awesome kind of runs in our family.
en: CHARLOTTE: Awesome kind of runs in our family.
ja: シャルロット: すごさは、あたしたちの家系の遺伝ってわけね。

key: No big deal.
en: No big deal.
ja: 大したことないけど。

key: Not that it does much good in this place.
en: Not that it does much good in this place.
ja: もっとも、こんな場所じゃ、あんまり役に立たないけどね。

key: ANNA: Charlotte and Noel are both Gym Leaders~
en: ANNA: Charlotte and Noel are both Gym Leaders~
ja: アンナ: シャルロットとノエル、二人ともジムリーダーなんだよ~

key: CHARLOTTE: Not that it does much good in this place.
en: CHARLOTTE: Not that it does much good in this place.
ja: シャルロット: もっとも、こんな場所じゃ、あんまり役に立たないけどね。

key: See, we're all stuck here until either we turn 18, or The Good Doctor finally decides to let us go.
en: See, we're all stuck here until either we turn 18, or The Good Doctor finally decides to let us go.
ja: あたしたち、18歳になるか、あの「良き先生」がようやく解放してくれるまで、ここから出られないの。

key: So, basically, forever.
en: So, basically, forever.
ja: つまり、ほぼ永遠にってこと。

key: NOEL: The Doctor is scary.
en: NOEL: The Doctor is scary.
ja: ノエル: あの先生、怖いんだ。

key: ANNA: Yeah! He has a really strong Electric-type Pokémon, and he uses it in his 'therapy'.
en: ANNA: Yeah! He has a really strong Electric-type Pokémon, and he uses it in his 'therapy'.
ja: アンナ: そう! すごく強いでんきタイプのポケモンを持ってて、「治療」に使うの。

key: Nostra says that she thinks he's hurt his past patients...
en: Nostra says that she thinks he's hurt his past patients...
ja: ノストラが言うには、前の患者たちを傷つけたことがあるかもって……

key: I think so too, because when you're around him, if you listen carefully, you can hear a ghostly voice.
en: I think so too, because when you're around him, if you listen carefully, you can hear a ghostly voice.
ja: あたしもそう思う、だって彼のそばにいるとき、よく聞くと幽霊みたいな声が聞こえるから。

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, I still don't know about that one.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, I still don't know about that one.
ja: シャルロット: まあ、それについては、あたしはまだよくわからないけど。

key: ANNA: So, \PN, what are you here for?
en: ANNA: So, \PN, what are you here for?
ja: アンナ: それで、\PN、ここには何しに来たの?

key: Someone you know needs help?
en: Someone you know needs help?
ja: 知り合いが助けを必要としてるの?

key: Oh, no!
en: Oh, no!
ja: ああ、だめ!

key: That's terrible, but you mustn't bring her here!
en: That's terrible, but you mustn't bring her here!
ja: それはひどい話だけど、彼女をここに連れてきちゃだめ!

key: That'll only make her worse!
en: That'll only make her worse!
ja: それじゃ、もっと悪くなっちゃうだけだもん!

key: Hold on...
en: Hold on...
ja: 待って……

key: Nostra says the Doctor is coming! Eep!
en: Nostra says the Doctor is coming! Eep!
ja: ノストラが、先生が来るって言ってる! ひゃっ!

key: ???: Ah, a visitor.
en: ???: Ah, a visitor.
ja: ???: ああ、来客か。

key: I was right to wonder at the noise.
en: I was right to wonder at the noise.
ja: 物音を気にしたのは、正しかったようだな。

key: SIGMUND: Greetings.
en: SIGMUND: Greetings.
ja: シグムンド: ごきげんよう。

key: I am Dr. Sigmund Connal, but you may refer to me simply as "Doctor".
en: I am Dr. Sigmund Connal, but you may refer to me simply as "Doctor".
ja: 私はシグムンド・コナル医師です。ですが、単に「先生」とお呼びいただいて構いません。

key: How can I help you?
en: How can I help you?
ja: どのようなご用件でしょうか?

key: ANNA: Erm, well, \PN just heard that there were Gym Leaders here, and came by because of that!
en: ANNA: Erm, well, \PN just heard that there were Gym Leaders here, and came by because of that!
ja: アンナ: えっと、その、\PNはここにジムリーダーがいるって聞いて、それで来たんです!

key: Yeah, that's it!
en: Yeah, that's it!
ja: そう、それだけ!

key: Nothing else, hehe.
en: Nothing else, hehe.
ja: それ以外は何も、へへ。

key: SIGMUND: Is that all?
en: SIGMUND: Is that all?
ja: シグムンド: それだけですか?

key: Well, then.
en: Well, then.
ja: それでは。

key: Indeed, there are some particularly gifted individuals in our care.
en: Indeed, there are some particularly gifted individuals in our care.
ja: 確かに、当施設には特に才能に恵まれた者が何人かおります。

key: Several of them were able to inherit or earn high-ranking positions.
en: Several of them were able to inherit or earn high-ranking positions.
ja: その中には、高い地位を継承あるいは獲得した者もおります。

key: You must have some degree of confidence in your skill as well.
en: You must have some degree of confidence in your skill as well.
ja: あなたも、ご自身の腕前にはそれなりの自信をお持ちなのでしょう。

key: Hrm.
en: Hrm.
ja: ふむ。

key: Orderly John, please conduct a brief examination of this challenger.
en: Orderly John, please conduct a brief examination of this challenger.
ja: 介助員ジョン、この挑戦者を簡単に調べてくれ。

key: ORDERLY: Yes, Doctor.
en: ORDERLY: Yes, Doctor.
ja: 介助員: はい、先生。

key: SIGMUND: Begin.
en: SIGMUND: Begin.
ja: シグムンド: 始めなさい。

key: Well done.
en: Well done.
ja: お見事です。

key: SIGMUND: Most impressive, \PN.
en: SIGMUND: Most impressive, \PN.
ja: シグムンド: 実に見事です、\PN。

key: SIGMUND: However, I am afraid I cannot permit a proper battle with my clients at this time.
en: SIGMUND: However, I am afraid I cannot permit a proper battle with my clients at this time.
ja: シグムンド: しかし、残念ながら、現時点で当施設の患者との正式な対戦を許可するわけにはまいりません。

key: We're currently renovating our arena, and the common areas are unsuited to large-scale battles.
en: We're currently renovating our arena, and the common areas are unsuited to large-scale battles.
ja: 現在、闘技場を改修中でして、共用区域は大規模な対戦には適していないのです。

key: Furthermore, intense conflict with official stakes is a common precipitating factor for even non- participating clients' affects.
en: Furthermore, intense conflict with official stakes is a common precipitating factor for even non- participating clients' affects.
ja: さらに、公式な対戦という激しい衝突は、対戦しない患者の情緒にとってさえ、しばしば悪影響の誘因となります。

key: It is regrettable, but it cannot be helped.
en: It is regrettable, but it cannot be helped.
ja: 残念ですが、致し方ありません。

key: You'll simply have to wait until a different time.
en: You'll simply have to wait until a different time.
ja: また別の機会にお待ちいただくしかないでしょう。

key: ANNA: Well! That's too bad~
en: ANNA: Well! That's too bad~
ja: アンナ: あら! 残念ですね~

key: Guess \PN will just have to be leaving now!
en: Guess \PN will just have to be leaving now!
ja: \PNはもう帰るしかないみたいですね!

key: SIGMUND: Hold, Anna.
en: SIGMUND: Hold, Anna.
ja: シグムンド: 待ちなさい、アンナ。

key: You seem quite eager to dismiss him.
en: You seem quite eager to dismiss him.
ja: ずいぶんと、彼を追い払いたがっているようだが。

key: You seem quite eager to dismiss her.
en: You seem quite eager to dismiss her.
ja: ずいぶんと、彼女を追い払いたがっているようだが。

key: You seem quite eager to dismiss them.
en: You seem quite eager to dismiss them.
ja: ずいぶんと、この方を追い払いたがっているようだが。

key: ANNA: Who, me?
en: ANNA: Who, me?
ja: アンナ: え、あたしが?

key: No, not at all!
en: No, not at all!
ja: いいえ、全然そんな!

key: Why would I be, haha!
en: Why would I be, haha!
ja: なんでそんなこと、あはは!

key: SIGMUND: ...
en: SIGMUND: ...
ja: シグムンド: ……

key: Anna, do we need to have another discussion about manipulating others based on your hallucinations?
en: Anna, do we need to have another discussion about manipulating others based on your hallucinations?
ja: アンナ、お前の幻覚をもとに他人を操ろうとすることについて、また話し合う必要があるのかね?

key: ANNA: No!
en: ANNA: No!
ja: アンナ: ない!

key: SIGMUND: ...Right.
en: SIGMUND: ...Right.
ja: シグムンド: ……そうか。

key: Why don't you tell me why you're really here, \PN?
en: Why don't you tell me why you're really here, \PN?
ja: \PN、本当の目的を教えていただけますか?

key: The Lapis Ward Gym Leader, then?
en: The Lapis Ward Gym Leader, then?
ja: それでは、ラピス区のジムリーダーの件ですね?

key: I see.
en: I see.
ja: なるほど。

key: I suppose I can schedule a quick evaluation.
en: I suppose I can schedule a quick evaluation.
ja: 簡単な診察の予定を組むことはできるでしょう。

key: I have several other matters that require my immediate attention, but I will call on her a bit later.
en: I have several other matters that require my immediate attention, but I will call on her a bit later.
ja: 他にも早急に対応すべき用件がいくつかありますが、後ほど彼女のもとを訪ねましょう。

key: Thank you for letting me know.
en: Thank you for letting me know.
ja: お知らせいただき、ありがとうございます。

key: Do have a good day.
en: Do have a good day.
ja: それでは、良い一日を。

key: ANNA: Psst!
en: ANNA: Psst!
ja: アンナ: ねえねえ!

key: Nostra told me to tell you to tell her--
en: Nostra told me to tell you to tell her--
ja: ノストラが、あなたから彼女に伝えてって言ってるの――

key: Rather than feeling sad herself, she should think about helping the one who's most hurt by what happened!
en: Rather than feeling sad herself, she should think about helping the one who's most hurt by what happened!
ja: 自分が悲しむより、あの出来事で一番傷ついた人を助けることを考えてって!

key: If she does that, then she won't have time to feel bad!
en: If she does that, then she won't have time to feel bad!
ja: そうすれば、悲しんでる暇なんてなくなるから!

key: SIGMUND: Is something the matter?
en: SIGMUND: Is something the matter?
ja: シグムンド: どうかしたのですか?

key: Exactly what are you whispering about?
en: Exactly what are you whispering about?
ja: 一体、何をこそこそ話しているのです?

key: ANNA: Nothing!
en: ANNA: Nothing!
ja: アンナ: 何でもない!

key: Bye, \PN!
en: Bye, \PN!
ja: じゃあね、\PN!

key: SHELLY: Y-you came back!
en: SHELLY: Y-you came back!
ja: シェリー: も、戻ってきてくれたのね!

key: Okay... Let's go!
en: Okay... Let's go!
ja: よし……行きましょう!

key: What's going on?
en: What's going on?
ja: 何があったの?

key: SHELLY: They took my friend!
en: SHELLY: They took my friend!
ja: シェリー: あたしの友達が連れていかれちゃったの!

key: We're gonna get her back!
en: We're gonna get her back!
ja: 取り戻すわよ!

key: SHELLY: \PN, you have to leave?
en: SHELLY: \PN, you have to leave?
ja: シェリー: \PN、行かなきゃだめなの?

key: Even despite what's happening to Heather?
en: Even despite what's happening to Heather?
ja: ヘザーがこんな目に遭ってるのに?

key: Um... O-okay.
en: Um... O-okay.
ja: ええと……わ、わかった。

key: I'll just wait here, I guess...
en: I'll just wait here, I guess...
ja: ここで待ってる、と思う……

key: ANNA: Hi again!
en: ANNA: Hi again!
ja: アンナ: また会ったね!

key: I saw \PN's glowiness through the wall, so I unlocked the door~
en: I saw \PN's glowiness through the wall, so I unlocked the door~
ja: \PNの光ってるの、壁越しに見えたから、ドアの鍵開けたの~

key: CAIN: "Glowiness"?
en: CAIN: "Glowiness"?
ja: カイン: 「光ってる」?

key: ANNA: \PN glows! It's amazing!
en: ANNA: \PN glows! It's amazing!
ja: アンナ: \PN、光ってるの! すごいんだから!

key: Hi, I'm Anna! Nice to meet you!
en: Hi, I'm Anna! Nice to meet you!
ja: こんにちは、あたしアンナ! よろしくね!

key: CAIN: Haha, heyyy. I'm Cain.
en: CAIN: Haha, heyyy. I'm Cain.
ja: カイン: はは、やあ。僕はカイン。

key: You're pretty peppy~
en: You're pretty peppy~
ja: 元気いっぱいだね~

key: NOEL: She always is.
en: NOEL: She always is.
ja: ノエル: いつもこうなんです。

key: And always when it's least appropriate.
en: And always when it's least appropriate.
ja: しかも、決まって一番不適切なタイミングで。

key: ANNA: But that's when it's most necessary!
en: ANNA: But that's when it's most necessary!
ja: アンナ: だって、そういう時こそ一番必要なんだもん!

key: CHARLOTTE: So, like, why are you guys here?
en: CHARLOTTE: So, like, why are you guys here?
ja: シャルロット: それで、あんたたちは何しに来たわけ?

key: Is it about the girl that was just brought in?
en: Is it about the girl that was just brought in?
ja: さっき連れてこられた子のことで?

key: She was kicking and screaming the whole way.
en: She was kicking and screaming the whole way.
ja: ずっと蹴って叫んで大暴れだったわよ。

key: Not that that's unusual.
en: Not that that's unusual.
ja: まあ、珍しいことじゃないけど。

key: SHELLY: We're... um--
en: SHELLY: We're... um--
ja: シェリー: あたしたち……その――

key: We're going to save her!
en: We're going to save her!
ja: あの子を助けるの!

key: CAIN: Yeah, it's a prison break~
en: CAIN: Yeah, it's a prison break~
ja: カイン: そう、脱獄ってやつさ~

key: You guys wanna come?
en: You guys wanna come?
ja: 一緒に来る?

key: CHARLOTTE: Are you kidding?
en: CHARLOTTE: Are you kidding?
ja: シャルロット: 冗談でしょ?

key: I was halfway out the door by the time you said 'prison break'.
en: I was halfway out the door by the time you said 'prison break'.
ja: 「脱獄」って言い終わる頃には、もう半分ドアの外にいたわよ。

key: Metaphorically, if nothing else.
en: Metaphorically, if nothing else.
ja: 少なくとも、比喩的にはね。

key: SHELLY: W-well... we're not leaving without Heather!
en: SHELLY: W-well... we're not leaving without Heather!
ja: シェリー: そ、そう……ヘザーを置いていくつもりはないわ!

key: CHARLOTTE: Course you aren't.
en: CHARLOTTE: Course you aren't.
ja: シャルロット: そうでしょうとも。

key: 'Sides, it's only a matter of seconds until the orderlies crash the party and toss you out.
en: 'Sides, it's only a matter of seconds until the orderlies crash the party and toss you out.
ja: それに、介助員たちが乗り込んできてあんたたちを追い出すまで、あと何秒もないでしょ。

key: NOEL: Our Pokémon were confiscated, so we can't help.
en: NOEL: Our Pokémon were confiscated, so we can't help.
ja: ノエル: 僕たちのポケモンは没収されてるから、力になれません。

key: CHARLOTTE: Not with that attitude.
en: CHARLOTTE: Not with that attitude.
ja: シャルロット: その態度じゃ無理でしょうね。

key: I bet I can hold a few of them up for you.
en: I bet I can hold a few of them up for you.
ja: 何人かなら、あたしが足止めしてあげられると思うわ。

key: But if you don't come back for me, heads are gonna roll.
en: But if you don't come back for me, heads are gonna roll.
ja: でも、あたしを迎えに戻ってこなかったら、痛い目見せてやるから。

key: Deal?
en: Deal?
ja: それでいい?

key: CAIN: Deal.
en: CAIN: Deal.
ja: カイン: 決まりだね。

key: ANNA: Charlotte, what are you doing?
en: ANNA: Charlotte, what are you doing?
ja: アンナ: シャルロット、何してるの?

key: CHARLOTTE: Creating a diversion.
en: CHARLOTTE: Creating a diversion.
ja: シャルロット: 陽動作戦よ。

key: CHARLOTTE: Hey.
en: CHARLOTTE: Hey.
ja: シャルロット: ねえ。

key: CHARLOTTE: Hey, assholes.
en: CHARLOTTE: Hey, assholes.
ja: シャルロット: ちょっと、クソ野郎ども。

key: Give me my cigarettes.
en: Give me my cigarettes.
